name: learnmate
description: LearnMate — AI career guidance agent powered by IBM watsonx.ai

scripts.build: npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix backend
scripts.dev: concurrently --names "backend,frontend" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
